summary: The creator demonstrates two Corrosion team variations against Durem in the Continental Challenge mode. Both teams feature Reytah, Child of Chaos, Szecedith, Sacredeia, and Rook. The budget setup achieves 523M damage, focusing on survival using defensive gear on Child of Chaos. A higher-investment setup with Inspiration 2 Child of Chaos, Reytah's exclusive artifact, and Szecedith on front row achieves 1.14B damage.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos

heroes.note: Built with Puppet Master set and defensive stats for budget runs, or Inspiration 2 to significantly boost team damage and survivability.

tips: In budget Corrosion runs against Durem, prioritize defensive stats on Child of Chaos with the Puppet Master set to ensure team survival.
Higher team investment allows positioning Szecedith in the front row to survive hits easily and maximize team damage output.
